title: Q-COST-PROOF-2: run deploy/cost-probe.mjs on a daily server-side clock
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::cost-probe
**Status:** done

Q-COST-PROOF-1 built the probe and ran it once by hand. Add a daily server-side run (a tick step in seed/worker/src/tick.js or a workflow with the budget headers) that executes the probe, commits ops/cost.jsonl and files the items, with a clock entry in doctrine/clocks.json so a stopped probe is a defect.

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/tick.js

size: M
